name: privateplate
description: PrivatePlate — a household meal coordination Agent for smart fridges and home hubs

scripts.build: npm run build -w @privateplate/contracts && npm run build -w @privateplate/domain && npm run build -w @privateplate/agent-runtime && npm run build -w @privateplate/server && npm run build -w @privateplate/web && npm run build -w @privateplate/evals
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test -w @privateplate/contracts && npm run test -w @privateplate/domain && npm run test -w @privateplate/agent-runtime && npm run test -w @privateplate/server
scripts.test:c1: npm run test -w @privateplate/contracts && npm run test -w @privateplate/domain
scripts.test:eval-v2: npm run build -w @privateplate/contracts && npm run build -w @privateplate/domain && npm run build -w @privateplate/agent-runtime && npm run build -w @privateplate/server && npm run build -w @privateplate/evals && npm run test -w @privateplate/contracts && npm run test -w @privateplate/domain && npm run test -w @privateplate/agent-runtime && npm run test -w @privateplate/server && npm run test:v2 -w @privateplate/evals
scripts.agent:cli: npm run build -w @privateplate/agent-runtime && npm run cli -w @privateplate/agent-runtime
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w @privateplate/contracts && npm run build -w @privateplate/domain && npm run build -w @privateplate/agent-runtime && npm run dev -w @privateplate/server
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w @privateplate/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @privateplate/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @privateplate/domain && npm run typecheck -w @privateplate/agent-runtime && npm run typecheck -w @privateplate/server && npm run typecheck -w @privateplate/web && npm run typecheck -w @privateplate/evals
scripts.check: npm run test:eval-v2 && npm run test -w @privateplate/web && npm run typecheck && git diff --check
scripts.check:goai: npm run test:eval-v2 && npm run test -w @privateplate/web && npm run typecheck && git diff --check
